name: TOTAL FIT - Abu Hail
address: Granada Coffee Shop - Bldg - 3rd Floor - 288 Abu Hail St - near Emarat Petrol Pump - Hor Al Anz - Deira - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Total Fit Gym is the first step in your fitness journey. Our Gym is one of the best in U.A.E with best equipments and experienced trainers. We offer a wide range of services and help you in any way we can to reach your goals.

reviews.author: Abhijith AS
reviews.text: I've had a great experience at this gym. The equipment is excellent, the atmosphere is motivating, and the staff are very friendly. A special thanks to my trainer, Nandhu, for his dedication, patience, and constant encouragement. He explains every exercise clearly, keeps me motivated, and has helped me make steady progress toward my fitness goals. I highly recommend this gym, especially if you get the chance to train with Nandhu!

reviews.author: NIKHIL P V
reviews.text:
I’ve had a great experience at this gym. The atmosphere is motivating, the equipment is well-maintained, and the environment is clean and welcoming for everyone, whether you're a beginner or experienced.

A special mention to Ansar, who is an outstanding trainer. He is highly professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely dedicated to helping clients achieve their fitness goals. Ansar pays close attention to form and technique, provides personalized guidance, and constantly motivates you to push beyond your limits in a safe and effective way. His positive attitude and supportive approach make every workout session productive and enjoyable.

Highly recommend this gym, especially if you get the chance to train with Ansar! 💪

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing. One of the best gyms in UAE. The latest equipments, and enough space to exercise without feeling crowded. And the trainers are so helpful and supporting, and the managementis super friendly. Even the ambience makes you want to work out. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Telma Ntalabe
reviews.text:
I’ve had a wonderful experience at Total Fit Gym Abuhail. From day one, the trainers have been incredibly motivating and supportive. They have made my fitness journey much easier and more enjoyable than I ever imagined before starting. It has only been a month, and I already feel like I’m steadily moving toward my goals.

The gym itself is always clean, and the equipment is well organized, which creates a comfortable and positive environment to work out in.

A special thank you to Sarath, who truly teaches rather than just trains. He explains the purpose behind every exercise with clarity and precision, which helps me understand what I’m doing and why. That guidance makes a big difference.

Also, appreciation to Nandu, whose positive smile and constant encouragement add so much motivation to every session.

I’m really glad I chose this gym for my fitness goals, and I’m excited to see the amazing results ahead. Highly recommended!
